hist-econ-04-c1.text: Sandra Kollen Ghizoni. Creation of the Bretton Woods System. federalreservehistory.org.
hist-econ-04-c1.quote: A new international monetary system was forged by delegates from forty-four nations in Bretton Woods, New Hampshire, in July 1944.
hist-econ-04-c1.claim: The 1944 Bretton Woods conference designed the postwar monetary order.

hist-econ-04-c1.text: Sandra Kollen Ghizoni. Creation of the Bretton Woods System. federalreservehistory.org.
hist-econ-04-c1.quote: In 1971, President Richard Nixon ended the dollar's convertibility to gold.
hist-econ-04-c1.claim: The system collapsed when Nixon ended dollar-gold convertibility in 1971.
